newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU warns Slovakia on minority rights.
newsitem.headline: EU warns Slovakia on minority rights.

text.p: The European Commission has warned Slovakia to respect democracy and human rights or risk seeing its bid to be a member of the European Union founder.

In a statement issued after a meeting on Thursday with Slovak Deputy Prime Minister Kararina Tothova, the EU's external affaIrs commissioner said he had raised the need for respect for democracy, law, human rights and freedom of expression.
"It would be regrettable if doubts over Slovakia's ability to satisfy the political criteria for membership jeopardised its accession to the EU," the statement from Hans van den Broek said.
It said he had welcomed the Slovak parliament's decision not to accept "controversial" amendments to its penal code.

But van den Broek told Tothova that legislation on the use of minority languages, which had been promised by the Slovak government, had not been introduced and that this remained a major source of concern to the European Union.
Slovakia is one of 10 countries from the former communist bloc that have been promised eventual EU membership.
